name: Batteries
author: fredde
description: Every battery in the Omarchy bar: the laptop with its charge or discharge rate, time left and health, AirPods bud by bud (via librepods), and your mouse, keyboard, headset, controller and phone. Pick what the bar shows.

barWidget.description: The batteries you pick, each as an icon and level with a bolt while it charges. Click for the laptop's draw, time left and health, each AirPod and the case, and every peripheral.

schema.label: Show the laptop battery in the bar
Show the laptop's charge or discharge rate (W)
Show the laptop's time left or time to full
Show AirPods (the emptier bud)
schema.description: Needs the librepods daemon, which omapods installs.

schema.label: Show percentages next to the icons
Notify when a device or AirPods run low
Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Plugging or unplugging anything refreshes right away regardless. Peripherals shown in the bar are picked in the panel.

schema.label: Check for updates automatically
schema.description: Looks on GitHub every few hours; updating is always your click, in the panel's settings.
